office_does: The county assessor values all taxable property in Whitman County, calculates property tax levies for local taxing districts, and runs property tax exemption programs.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Assessor Wraylee Flodin, appointed in 2021 and elected since, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Whitman County Assessor since her July 2021 appointment, previously chief deputy treasurer. Unopposed in 2022 and again on this ballot.
highlights: Appointed assessor in July 2021 after four years in the treasurer's office, the last as chief deputy treasurer [S3]
Says she oversees the yearly review of more than 40,000 parcels and has updated assessment ratios to meet state requirements [S1]
Addressed a 2025 valuation-notice error affecting property owners in ten towns [S4]
